meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会引导你完成WhatsApp接入:先确认用专用还是共享号码,再通过扫码或配对码让手机配对,并设置助手名称等信息,最终让NanoClaw能收发WhatsApp消息。
howto.when: 当你要求给NanoClaw添加WhatsApp频道,或说到“接入WhatsApp”时触发。Claude会先做号码安全确认,再走扫码或配对码认证。

say.note: Claude会先确认号码选择并显示风险提示。
Claude会生成二维码,你用手机扫码配对。
Claude会给出8位配对码,你在手机上输入。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through connecting WhatsApp: it asks whether you use a dedicated or shared number, then pairs your phone via QR or pairing code, and sets assistant info so NanoClaw can send and receive WhatsApp messages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add or connect a WhatsApp channel, e.g. by saying 'add WhatsApp' or 'link my number'.

say_en.text: Help me add WhatsApp using a dedicated number.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm the number choice and show risk warning.

say_en.text: Connect WhatsApp using the QR code.
say_en.note: Claude will show a QR code for you to scan.

say_en.text: Connect WhatsApp using a pairing code.
say_en.note: Claude will give an 8-character code to enter on your phone.
